summary: For the shadow Cognition session, `[dreamer.budgets.cognition] max_memory_calls` and `max_tool_calls` now mean calls per agenda item, not per session.
details: A session's pass-wide memory and tool-call ceilings are those numbers times the agenda's item count, like each per-tool ceiling.
The session also gains two read tools, `rollup_read` and `standing_read`, held by no other pass.
limitations: The session mode ships off, so nothing changes until an operator turns shadow sessions on.
